dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: The previous adventure failed... But it's not the right time to give up!

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Now that we have the sponsorship from Mr. Vikram, it's bound to be successful this time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The previous adventure?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: The last time, the time before, and the time before before... It's always for the traces of King Deshret's kin!

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: You are here at Caravan Ribat. I presume you have heard of the legend of King Deshret among the desert inhabitants?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: The true "God of Wisdom" in the ancient times who was long forgotten... I don't know if this is true or not, but sounds like King Deshret was a god with many followers, right?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: So even if King Deshret doesn't exist anymore, there could still be some kin left... Like a dragon or something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Or perhaps a fox?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Ugh... Fox? Doesn't seem formidable to me...

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: An adventurer should have high expectations. Let's say, dragons, top of all elemental creatures!

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: ...Of course, you can set a bigger goal. But better address the actual problem first.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Anyways, my first little goal is... not to get lost outside Aaru Village just yet. The young lady in the village is quite kind, but it'd be embarrassing to trouble her all the time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The young lady?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Well, she's a nice person. She helped me out when I was lost in the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: When we first met, I was in shambles. She didn't recognize me in my green adventurer suit. She took me back to the village and gave me food and water after I explained to her what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: And after that... I bothered her several times, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: So if you're in danger in the desert, head to Aaru Village for help.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: She has a different color in each eye. You'll know at the sight of her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mr. Vikram?

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Yes, a generous Vahu{RUBY#[S]Aetiology}mana researcher. He's very interested in the legends of King Deshret, and has helped many adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: My adventure this time has been sponsored by him. I'm here helping him look for someone at Caravan Ribat and pass on a message.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: But the girl he's looking for seemed to have received the Dusk Bird and gone to Sumeru City already. Did I get it wrong...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: That was fun! Don't worry, I'm sure you'll beat me someday soon.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: I'm impressed! You're really good at this. Would you mind teaching a newbie some tricks?
